DETAILED ACTION
Reasons for Allowance
The following is the examiner’s statement of reasons for allowance: no prior art reference alone or in combination with any other teaches or suggests two sets of ultra-long cantilever trusses with arc-shaped facades and triquetrous planes, fixedly supported by the ground and symmetrical.  Further search and review of the prior art did not reveal any embodiments thereof or motivations to modify in such ways.  The examiner understands the term “several” to mean three or more, and “ultra-long” to correspond to the lengths and relative proportions represented in the illustration of Figure 3.
Any comments considered necessary by the Applicant must be submitted no later than the payment of the issue fee and, to avoid processing delays, should preferably accompany the issue fee.  Such submissions should be clearly labeled “Comments on Statement of Reasons for Allowance.”
